source_books: كتاب الطالب لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية للصف الثالث الفصل الثاني (g3-english-s2-pupils-book, Jordan Team Together series, Pearson/York Press)
meta.provenance_note: Unlike Semester 1, this semester has a real pupil's book. Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-18, extraction is clean (English text). Same approach as g3EnglishSem1/g5EnglishSem1: unit titles, vocabulary, grammar structures (with the book's own example sentences), and skill descriptors taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5), cross-checked row-by-row against the Contents page and each unit's own opener. Units are numbered 6-10, continuing Semester 1's 1-5 — this project's own linking convention (the book itself prints only 'Welcome' plus 4 numbered units, 5-8, with the Welcome unit unnumbered), same treatment as g3IslamicSem2/g4IslamicSem2. 'My favourite day!' (the Welcome unit) is included as u6, same as g5EnglishSem1's precedent of including a Welcome unit when it carries its own scope-and-sequence row — this one does, though its Vocabulary cell lists only category names (Activities/Clothes/Jobs) with no new items, since it reviews Semester 1's vocabulary rather than introducing new words.
known_gaps: Real content (vocabulary lists, grammar points with the book's own example sentences, skill descriptors), not title-only — but unit-level, not lesson-level: each unit's actual internal lesson count and exact per-lesson titles were not verified page by page, same scope as g3EnglishSem1/g5EnglishSem1.

`main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display, same convention as g3EnglishSem1.

u6_l1 (Vocabulary & Grammar, 'My favourite day!') has an empty `vocabulary` array: the scope-and-sequence table's Vocabulary cell for this unit lists only category names (Activities, Clothes, Jobs) with no actual word list — a review unit recapping Semester 1's vocabulary, not introducing new terms.
Phonics word lists printed inside the Vocabulary table cell are excluded from `vocabulary` (sound-pattern examples, not topical vocabulary), same exclusion as g3EnglishSem1.

Excluded as supplementary, non-core material (no dedicated row in the scope-and-sequence table): 'Atomic's Learning Club: Language booster 2', the Social Science spread ('What can we see on a map?'), the Festivals section (National Olive Festival, Eid al-Fitr, Aqaba Arts Festival), and the Reading/Writing/Phonics/Project/Viewing-and-presenting/Functions columns of the scope-and-sequence table (present in the source but not carried into this schema, same scope as g3EnglishSem1).

lessons.main_idea_ar: Present simple — statements and yes/no questions about habits. Examples: I/we play … He/She plays … Do you play … on Friday? Yes, I do./No, I don't. Does he/she play … at the weekend? Yes, he/she does./No, he/she doesn't.

lessons.main_idea_ar: Identifying everyday objects and people from short basic descriptions; recognising familiar key words and phrases in short, basic descriptions; getting the gist of a simple song, if supported by gestures. Answering simple questions about habits and daily routines; acting out a short dialogue or role play; reciting a short, simple rhyme or chant.
